title: gymnopteris ehrenbergiana
intro: Gymnopteris ehrenbergiana, commonly known as the Indian brake fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. The Indian brake fern has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. It has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions like arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Gymnopteris ehrenbergiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
